harness.source: docs/evidence/m61a_cloud/observation_7f4c30f/tools/ (the files used by run_03; run_02 used them after a mid-run edit)

procedure.wait: both controllers active in ros2 control list_controllers (ANSI stripped) + 3 s
procedure.stop: SIGINT to the launch process group, ros2 daemon stop, Xvfb stop, leftover check

scan.seam_mask_rule: beams within 1 deg (float <= 1.0) of the gpu_lidar cube-map seams at lidar-frame -135, -45, +45, +135 deg; justification: in all three runs beams 45, 135 and 225 returned the range of a neighbouring direction (errors 2.38-2.68 m) while their neighbours were normal; Gazebo renders gpu_lidar through 90 deg camera faces whose seams are at these angles
scan.seam_mask_note: float rounding makes the mask asymmetric (46/136/226/316 masked, 44/134/224/314 not); 315 is masked but was never an outlier. Frozen as an explicit index list; any change is a new, reviewed definition
scan.edge_grazing_rule: exclude a beam whose expected range changes > 0.05 m within +-0.5 deg (at the evaluated pose); at the weld pose this excludes indices [117, 118, 210, 222, 309, 334]
scan.fit: robust Gauss-Newton of the lidar planar pose: beams re-selected each iterate, Huber weight 0.02 m, step clip 0.05, <= 40 iterations; 1 sigma from MAD (robust) and from RMS (reported)

criteria.1b: 120 s observation READY at its end
criteria.3: pose receipt max gap < 1.0 s wall (p99.9 recorded); joint-state sim gap max <= 0.25 s
criteria.4: no unexpected pose sample codes; header.frame_id recorded, not gated
criteria.5: GUI screenshot shows the feet clear of the floor (foot-level view: eye 8 mm above the floor, 0.4 m to the side); qualitative
criteria.6a: GATED: seam-masked robust fit |dxy| <= 0.008 m and robust 1 sigma |xy| < 0.008 m
criteria.6b: GATED: seam-masked per-surface median residual |median| <= 0.008 m
criteria.6c: REPORTED: fraction of individual seam- and grazing-masked beams within +-0.008 m, by incidence band; the strict per-beam reading of M0 is an owner decision
criteria.6-raw: REPORTED: the same fit with no seam mask
criteria.7: ros2 action info clients 0, ros2 topic info publishers 0, observer action_clients and command_publishers 0 at start and end
criteria.8: launch process group empty after SIGINT; no leftover process
criteria.M: /robot_description weld world->dummy_link xyz 0 0 0.125 rpy 0; Gazebo dummy_link pose (0, 0, 0.125)
criteria.Z: no goal line in the launch log; 0 command-topic messages and 0 goal statuses in the capture; observer goals_sent 0 and publishers_created 0
criteria.H1: supplementary: controller reference (controller_state reference / state desired) change <= 1e-9 rad over the capture
criteria.H2: supplementary: joint-state positions change <= 1e-9 rad over the capture
